Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_LootMult_toolt: Multiplies the materials you get from dismantling a vehicle or a wreck. 1.0 = vanilla. In multiplayer the server applies it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_DismantleWeldi: Welding level needed to dismantle a working vehicle. 0 = no requirement. Wrecks stay vanilla.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_DismantleTimeM: Multiplies the time it takes to dismantle a working vehicle. 1.0 = same as a wreck.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_Repair_tooltip: Adds repair methods for every vehicle part, and lets you repair parts while they are installed. Off = vanilla repairs only.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_RepairTimeMult: Multiplies the time of the repair methods this mod adds.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_RepairXPMult_t: Multiplies the XP from a successful repair with the methods this mod adds. 1.0 = vanilla.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_Salvage_toolti: Lets you break removed vehicle parts down into materials.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_SalvageMult_to: Multiplies the number of extra material rolls when salvaging a part. 1.0 = 3 rolls.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_EngineRebuild_: Lets you raise engine quality with spare engine parts once the engine is at full condition.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_EngineRebuildP: Engine Rebuild: Spare Parts per Step
Spare engine parts used each time. Each step adds 10 quality.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_Keys_tooltip: Lets you make a key for a hotwired vehicle, remove the hotwire, and copy vehicle keys. Off = none of the three.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_KeysWelding: Make a Key: Welding Level Required
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_KeysWelding_to: Welding level needed to make a key for a hotwired vehicle.
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_KeysMechanics: Make a Key: Mechanics Level Required
Sandbox_MinidoracatAnyCar_KeysMechanics_: Mechanics level needed to make a key for a hotwired vehicle.
